## AI tutorials

- [x] `ai.ui.primitives` T3 UI Automation snapshot, guarded mouse/keyboard input and app launch for agents (target lock, kill hotkey, no password typing)

- [x] `ai.tutor.produce` T3 Produce the tutorial video: chapter cards, idle trim, smooth zoom, click rings, burned-in captions, SRT and chapter list
